info.title: Elevant API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API for the Elevant platform.

get.summary: ADR-0035: the simulated e-CF invoice PDF, addressed by the invoice id.

Where the airline stands with AVIAM (2-N32, 2-N35): overall status, read-only when no contract covers a
station today, the stations of its approved contracts (the treasury scope) and why each contract that
never activated is still waiting. The bootstrap keeps describing only what is in force today.

post.summary: A representative invites a user by email; the activation email is queued, never sent from here.
A representative deactivates or reactivates another user, never itself nor another representative.
A representative lets another user sign contracts and submit the JAC permit, or takes it back.

get.summary: Returns the current revision in each lane, rechecking live access.

put.summary: Appends only the current OCC user's lane revision.
Appends only the active assigned agent's lane revision.

post.summary: Exchanges valid Development credentials for a short-lived bearer token.

get.summary: Returns the current actor after revalidating its effective scope in SQL.

post.summary: Completes a portal login with the 6-digit code sent by email.
Sends a new code for a pending portal login; the earlier code stops working.

Renews the session with a refresh token, which is replaced in the same call (ADR-0021).
409 `refresh_rotated` means another tab renewed it a moment ago: re-read the stored token.
Ends the session: every refresh token of its family stops working.
Changes a verified password, then requires a fresh login.

Checks the airline against public registries (Wikidata, then OpenFlights) and stores the
verdict; a green check allows publishing it in step 2 of the public wizard (ADR-0023).

put.summary:
Saves the profile with the `version` the superadministrator saw. The Idempotency-Key is
optional while older clients exist (expand). The legal name, codes and verification of an
airline that already operates with AVIAM are fixed (`airline_identity_locked`, 1-N20).

delete.summary: Deprecated alias of the retirement without a reason; the same checks apply.

post.summary:
«Dar de baja» (1-N03): the service leaves the public catalog, new contracts and the operation. It is
refused with `service_in_active_contract` while a contract in force or in approval uses it, as a
rate or inside a package. The Idempotency-Key and `expectedVersion` are required.

Creates the airline's portal account: an emailed invitation by default, a temporary password
as the explicit alternative. The Idempotency-Key and `expectedVersion` (the request
version) are optional while older clients exist (expand); a key without the version is
rejected. An email that already has an account answers `email_has_account` when it can be
linked instead.

Completes the request with the existing portal account of the email (1-N13): one of the same
airline, or one without an airline, which joins it. Its credentials do not change.

Queues a new activation link for an airline account that has not activated yet (ADR-0022); the
earlier links stop working and their queued emails are discarded. The Idempotency-Key and
`expectedVersion` (the account version) are optional while older clients exist (expand).

get.summary:
Inbox with server-side filter, search and paging, and the counters per status. By default it
lists the open requests (pending and in review), oldest first.

post.summary:
Verifies the request's airline with an official source; the first verification moves the
request to «En revisión». A proposed airline is linked to an existing profile or gets a new
verified and published one.
Records who confirmed the representative, when and how; approval requires it.
Cancels a pending or in-review request with a reason; nothing is deleted.

Approves or rejects. The Idempotency-Key and `expectedVersion` are optional while older
clients exist (expand); a key without the version is rejected. Approval returns the contract.

get.summary:
Surcharges and packages that apply to the version (2-N04), for the same readers as the document:
whether they are part of its signed content and whether both parties signed it.

post.summary:
Contratos withdraws, with a reason, an approved version both parties have not signed (2-N10): it
becomes Rejected and keeps its approval; a one-party signature is voided in the audit trail.

get.summary: Review PDF of a draft version, watermarked «BORRADOR» and never signable.

put.summary:
Contratos confirms validity, renewal and termination of an approved version before anyone
signs it, and the contract gets its final code (ADR-0025). The Idempotency-Key is optional while
older clients exist (expand); with it a retry replays the first result.

post.summary:
The airline comments its draft, also while Finance reviews it. The Idempotency-Key and
`expectedVersion` are optional while older portals exist; a key without the version is rejected.

schema.description: An airline observation; `expectedVersion` is the draft rowversion the airline read.
An airline observation; `expectedVersion` is the draft rowversion the airline read.
An airline observation; `expectedVersion` is the draft rowversion the airline read.

put.summary:
Saves terms, validity, currency, rates and charges. The Idempotency-Key and `expectedVersion`
are optional while older clients exist (expand); a key without the version is rejected.

post.summary:
«Enviar a Finanzas» when every readiness rule holds; answers the contract. The body with
`expectedVersion` and the Idempotency-Key are optional while older clients exist (expand).

get.summary: Whether the draft can go to Finance, every blocking cause and the portal account status.
The services and stations of the draft and the active ones that can be added.

put.summary:
Sets the services and stations of a draft: kept services keep their rates, new ones start from
the Finance base tariff unconfirmed, and only active catalog services can be added.

post.summary:
Discards a draft or a version awaiting Finance with a reason. When it was the only live version of
a contract that never activated, the contract is terminated too. Nothing is deleted.
Contratos answers the airline on the draft; the answer appears in the portal.

The airline submits a permit of its dossier. The Idempotency-Key is optional while older portals exist
(expand, 2-N09); with it a retry answers the permit the first attempt created. A scan uploaded before
the media link window answers `document_expired` and must be uploaded again (2-N37).

Contratos verifies or rejects a submitted permit with the version it saw; any other permit answers 409
`review_closed` (2-N09). The answer adds the contracts the review activated or resumed (2-N30). The
Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist (expand).

Contratos revokes a verified permit with a reason and the version it saw (2-N09). The permit becomes
Revoked and keeps its original verification; the active contracts left without a usable operating
permit are suspended in the same transaction and the airline is emailed. The answer names them.

get.summary:
History of the contract. The airline reads its own contracts without internal names or the
internal reason of a Finance return (1-N05).

post.summary:
Suspend, reactivate, terminate (also «Descartar contrato» for one that never activated), cancel a
scheduled termination or renew, with a reason and the status the user saw. A termination of an
active or suspended contract takes `effectiveOn` (at least today plus the signed notice) or an
`immediateCause` (`Breach` or `MutualAgreement`, 2-N14). The Idempotency-Key is
optional while older clients exist (expand); with it a retry replays the first result.

get.summary: Employees of the department that can be given access (ADR-0017).
Audit trail of the department: sign-ins, governance and operational actions of its people.

post.summary: Deprecated (ADR-0017): members are requested for an employee and validated by Human Resources.

Names a department administrator from an employee. The Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist
(2-N39): a retry with the same key, body and temporary password replays the account.

Super administrator only: registers the employee and creates its account (administrator or
member with per-option permissions) in one step, without a Human Resources request.

put.summary:
Edits a user's access with the version on screen: an employee's stations come from the employee record
(`stations_outside_employee`), a legacy CUSTOM_* member becomes a Contracts member and a transferred
account is refused (`employee_transferred`). Optional Idempotency-Key (2-N39).

post.summary:
Deactivates or reactivates a user with the version on screen; only the employee's current department brings a
transferred account back, through a validated request (`employee_transferred`). Optional Idempotency-Key.

Adds a portal user to an airline (invitation by email, or a temporary password); its representatives hear of
it. The Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist (2-N39).

Designates a representative (manages the airline's portal users and signs) or a signer (signs contracts and
submits the JAC permit) with the account version on screen and an Idempotency-Key (2-N20). The last active
representative keeps the role (`last_representative`).

Sets a temporary password the user must change at the next sign-in. On an invitation that is
still pending it accepts the invitation, retires its links and discards its queued email (1-N12).
The Idempotency-Key and `expectedVersion` (the account version) are optional while older
clients exist (expand); a key without the version is rejected.

Converts a legacy CUSTOM_* role into a Contracts template; members already edited keep their permissions
(2-N19). The body (`expectedVersion`) and the Idempotency-Key are optional while older clients exist; a
key needs the version (2-N39).

put.summary: Confirms the prepayment; the same amount and reference again are a retry.
Sets the ground time of Narrowbody or Widebody; send the version you read.

post.summary: Adds a holiday; the same date and name again is a retry.

get.summary: ADR-0035: the simulated e-CF invoice PDF, addressed by the invoice id.

The «Factura emitida» emails of the invoice and their delivery state (1-N08): queued, sent,
failed or discarded, or none when the airline has no active portal account nor billing email.

post.summary:
Finance discards a package draft with a reason (1-N27, `finance.packages.delete`); the draft is
kept as Discarded. Idempotency-Key and the expected version are required.

Finance retires a published package with a reason (1-N27, `finance.packages.retire`): Contratos can
no longer link it and Finance does not approve drafts that still do; approved contracts keep it.

Contratos amends an active or suspended contract from any of its versions (1-C): a new draft from
the latest approved version, starting on `validFrom` and ending when that version ends, with
its rates unconfirmed. The token is the contract status the user saw. No client used the earlier
shape, so the Idempotency-Key is required without an expand phase. Answers the new draft version.

get.summary: Exports a report as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM) or PDF; every export is audited.

post.summary:
Finance approves the prices or returns the version to Contratos. Every failure carries a code,
one per blocking cause (1-N07). The Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist
(expand); with it the same key and body replay the first result.
Retired (2-N38): templates replace custom roles; answers 410 `legacy_governance_retired`.

put.summary: Retired (2-N38): templates replace custom roles; answers 410 `legacy_governance_retired`.

post.summary:
Retired (2-N38): accounts belong to employees; departments request them and Gestión Humana validates them.
Answers 410 `legacy_governance_retired`.

put.summary:
Retired (2-N38): access is edited from the department's users and the employee record. Answers 410
`legacy_governance_retired`.

get.summary: Lists the station's assignment evidence for an operation-date interval.

put.summary: Appends an immutable, revision-bound G.H. validation decision.

post.summary:
Approves, rejects or cancels a pending request. Approving a day off or a restriction releases the agent's
coverages, unstarted operations and unstarted shifts of those days (2-N08); an operation in progress keeps
the agent (`agent_has_operation_in_progress`). The Idempotency-Key and the expected version are
optional while older clients exist (expand); a key needs the version.

Cancels an approved absence that has not started, or shortens one that has not ended to a last day no
earlier than yesterday (2-N22). Always with a reason, the version on screen and an Idempotency-Key; what
the approval released does not come back.

Transfers the employee; leaving the ramp releases the agent's coverages, unstarted operations and shifts
(2-N06). The Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist (expand).

Terminates the employee on a date up to AVIAM's today (2-N31) and releases their ramp work (2-N06). The
Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist (expand).

get.summary: People-governance audit trail; `human_resources.audit.read` or the super administrator.

delete.summary:
Removes a shift of today or later in its station's calendar (ADR-0026, 2-N31); past shifts are history
(`shift_in_past`) and a shift whose agent already covers stands or carries operations in it stays
(`shift_in_use`, 2-N11). The expected version travels as `?version=`; it and the
Idempotency-Key are optional while older clients exist (expand), and a key needs the version.

patch.summary:
«Ajustar horario» (3-E): Gestión Humana and OCC change the hours of a shift of today or later in its station's
calendar, with a reason, the shift's `version` and an Idempotency-Key (required). The adjusted shift keeps
covering the agent's coverages and operations in it (`shift_uncovers_work`); a past shift
(`shift_in_past`) or one whose attendance was validated (`attendance_validated`) stays as it is.

put.summary: Creates or refreshes the current account's fail-closed device binding.

post.summary:
The agent signs out and frees the tablet it holds (2-N02). The Idempotency-Key is scoped to the installation:
a retry with the same key and body answers the first result. Only the account holding the tablet releases
it (`device_not_bound` otherwise).

Hands an agent their stands for a window of the shift (ADR-0030). 3-J: with an Idempotency-Key (optional while
older clients exist) a repeated attempt answers the board instead of a second coverage; the key with another body
is `idempotency_conflict`.
Releases a coverage; releasing twice answers the board. The Idempotency-Key works as in the creation.

Releases the agent of an operation not yet started so OCC can assign another (ADR-0030). 3-J:
`expectedAssignmentId` is the assignment OCC saw (another one is `assignment_changed`) and the
Idempotency-Key replays the release; both are optional while older clients exist, and a key needs the assignment
(`expected_version_required`). A started operation is `operation_started`: OCC hands it over instead.

get.summary:
«Relevar agente» (3-F): the agents who may take an operation in progress or returned for correction from its agent,
with OCC's assignment rules over what is left of it. Another status is `handover_not_allowed`.

post.summary:
«Relevar agente» (3-F): OCC hands an operation in progress or returned to another eligible agent, with the
assignment it saw (`assignment_changed` otherwise), a reason of 5 to 500 characters and an Idempotency-Key
(required). The operation keeps its status and evidence; both agents are told.

get.summary: «Mis posiciones de hoy»: the signed-in ramp agent's stand coverages for the next hours.

The proposals of a station and date. `view` is `Contracted` (default: airlines with a contract
in force that day), `Charter` (carriers without contract, ADR-0033) or `Dismissed` (2-N36).
Airlines whose contract at the station is suspended or expired are in none (2-N16).

post.summary:
«Actualizar ahora»: one provider read of the active window, at most every ten minutes per
station, reusing a read of the last five minutes and counted in the budget.

Creates the turnaround of a proposed arrival and its departure, optionally with its aircraft type, stand
and as a charter without contract (2-B, ADR-0033). The Idempotency-Key is optional while older screens
exist (expand): without it repeating the pair returns the same turnaround; with it the expected versions
of both proposals are required and a retry replays the first result.
Hides a proposal OCC will not operate; «Descartadas» keeps it while its flight has not passed.

Brings a dismissed proposal back to the review while its flight has not passed (2-N36), with the version
OCC saw and an Idempotency-Key; a retry replays the first result.
Frees the tablet: the next agent who signs in on it holds it, whatever the previous agent was doing.

Revokes a lost tablet with a reason: the installation never registers again and the sessions of the account
that held it end.

get.summary: The current form as PDF, with its signatures and content hash.
Returns the planning snapshot for an authorized station and operation date.
Returns contract services and agent eligibility for one scoped turnaround.

ETag.description: Strong, opaque version of the current OCC planning representation.

get.summary: Returns current contract airlines and airports for manual OCC entry.

post.summary: Creates one contract-covered manual flight and planned operation.
Programs one scoped agent shift before the normal OCC assignment.

get.summary:
The shift an agent already has on the flight's day (3-E), with its version, so OCC adjusts it with
`AdjustHumanResourcesShift` instead of programming a second one; 404 `shift_not_found` when there is none.

post.summary: Assigns one eligible agent and materializes all applicable contracted services.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest OCC planning options response.

ETag.description: Strong, opaque version of the current OCC planning representation.

post.summary:
Records the arrival (registration, actual on-block time and optionally the aircraft type) or corrects a recorded
one with its reason before the first submission (3-N08).

put.summary: Places a stand on the map, or clears it (ADR-0027).

get.summary: Returns the bounded latest-submission queue for one authorized station.
Returns the latest submitted execution and its review evidence.
Lists immutable handoff revisions for one scoped operation, newest first.
Reads one immutable historical handoff, including its review decision.

post.summary: OCC adds a charge to a service of the operation it is reviewing (ADR-0034).
OCC removes a charge from the operation it is reviewing, whoever marked it (ADR-0034).
Approves or returns one pending submission using its strong snapshot token.

get.summary: The turnaround, its version (also the ETag) and the changes its state allows.

put.summary:
«Editar vuelo»: corrects numbers, airports, times, stand and aircraft type before the operation starts. The stand
is checked again for the new window, and an assigned agent must still be on shift and within three simultaneous
operations (`assigned_agent_unavailable` with its reasons).

post.summary: «Cancelar vuelo» or «Marcar desviado» before the start: the stand and the agents are released.

Registers a carrier without contract for a charter (3-N21): 201 the first time, 200 when the key replays it. A
designator already in use answers `airline_code_in_use` with the `airlineId` that holds it.

put.summary: Marks the conversation read up to a message (ADR-0029); used for unread counts and «visto».

post.summary: Confirms the email of an invited portal account and sets its first password.
Sends a reset link when a portal account uses this email. Always answers 202.
Sets a new password from a reset link; every open session ends.
Superadmin smoke test: queues an email to check the no-reply sender.

get.summary: Latest emails with their delivery state (no bodies), for the superadmin.

The outbox for the superadmin (1-N22): filter by status (`All`, `Pending`, `Sent`,
`Failed` or `Discarded`), the normalized reason of each email and the contract,
invoice, payment, account or request it is about. Bodies are never returned.
The charter of the operation; 404 when the flight has a contract.

post.summary: Adds a service to the charter at the base tariff; one line per service.

put.summary: Records the carrier's address and who pays, as the representative gives them.

get.summary: Forms of the operation with what each still needs signed.

put.summary: Records a drawn signature on the form whose content hash the signer saw.

Marks a damage found in the 360° walk-around; the id comes from the tablet. Its time must fit the operation's
window (409 `time_outside_operation_window`, 3-N25).
Attaches the photo of a marked damage: JPEG or PNG, one per mark; the same bytes again are a retry.

Records (or corrects) the time of one Flight Report milestone. The time must fit the operation's window (from
its start or recorded arrival to its close, 409 `time_outside_operation_window`) and block-on never comes
after push-back (409 `milestone_out_of_order`, 3-N25).

Saves passengers, MTOW, the registration correction and the aircraft type typed once on the ramp (3-B). A null
aircraft type keeps the current one; an unknown or inactive type answers `aircraft_type_unavailable` and a
change after the first submission `aircraft_type_locked`, both 409 as before.

get.summary: Returns canonical incidents visible to the assigned ramp agent.

post.summary:
Atomically reports one incident without duplicating offline retries. Its time must fit the operation's window
(409 `time_outside_operation_window`, 3-N25).

get.summary: Returns the canonical checklist assigned to one accessible operation.

post.summary: Atomically submits every answer in one operation checklist.

get.summary:
The operations of the current ramp agent's queue (3-N01): assigned, in progress, handed over (pending or in review)
and returned, then the ones OCC approved in the last 48 hours; the active ones first, at most 100.

post.summary:
Starts one operation assigned to the authenticated ramp agent. The body is optional (3-I): the first version
of the app posts no body and the server's time applies; a newer one sends the moment the agent tapped
«Iniciar», which must not precede the assignment nor be more than a day old (409
`time_outside_operation_window`).

Applies one audited, idempotent service status transition. The optional `occurredAt` is the moment the
agent tapped it (3-I): it must fit the operation's window and not precede the service's last transition (409
`time_outside_operation_window`, `service_time_out_of_order`).
Atomically closes execution and records an idempotent submission.

get.summary: Charges the agent may mark on each service, and the ones already marked. Never includes prices.

post.summary: Marks (Apply) or unmarks (Remove) one charge on a service; idempotent per device and key.

Approves or denies a pending request. The Idempotency-Key is optional while older clients exist
(expand); `version` is the request rowversion on screen.

Republishes a service its approved closure hid, with a reason; a retired service answers
`service_retired` until it is reactivated. The Idempotency-Key is optional while older
clients exist (expand); `serviceVersion` is the service rowversion on screen.
A new station; its code is the IATA code of its airport (a new airport needs its data).

put.summary: Renames the station, changes its time zone while it has no history, deactivates or reactivates it.

delete.summary: Retires a supplier while preserving its invoices and payment history.

get.summary: Confirms that the HTTP process is responding.
«¿Puede operar?» of every active ramp agent, with what is missing.
The ramp agent's shifts (up to 31 days) and current documents.

ContractDraftCommentRequest.description: An airline observation; `expectedVersion` is the draft rowversion the airline read.

Bearer.description: Short-lived ELEVANT access token issued by POST /api/v1/auth/session.
